metrics.investment_case_interpretation: 折后可分配现金利润为正，且历史信号日市值 / 折后可分配现金利润约 7.88 倍，低于 15 倍门槛；扣除折后可剥离净资金后，经营业务购买价约 9,309.8 万港元，控股回本约 6.71 年。

cash_breakdown.item: cash at banks and in hand outside disclosed PRC/Vietnam bank deposits
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group cash not proven to be held directly by the listed parent; ordinary operating subsidiaries require a discount even though no restriction is disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Derived from cash at banks and in hand HK$22.965m less disclosed PRC/Vietnam bank deposits HK$11.287m.

cash_breakdown.item: PRC and Vietnam bank deposits included in cash and cash equivalents
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report says these deposits are subject to PRC and Vietnam exchange control restrictions; not treated as freely upstreamable parent cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Still ordinary operating cash rather than customer or regulatory funds, so a partial haircut is used instead of zero.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Deposits mature in one to three months, but jurisdiction and parent/subsidiary split are not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Short maturity supports detachability after retaining operating cash.

cash_breakdown.item: financial assets at FVPL - Hong Kong listed equity securities
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed equity securities are liquid Level 1 assets, but market price risk and disposal friction require a material haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not core manufacturing operating assets; treated as sellable financial assets.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: A manufacturing/export business with HK$303.5m revenue, HK$217.1m cost of sales, concentrated customers and working-capital swings needs liquidity; retained about one month of cash operating costs.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deducted from discounted detachable cash assets before computing detachable net cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank and trust receipt loans are fully deducted when present; 2023 year-end balance was nil.
Ordinary operating lease liability is small and relates to continuing business use; not mechanically deducted from detachable cash, reflected in cash profit quality instead.
cash_breakdown.reason: Current and non-current lease liabilities totaled HK$0.501m.

profit_quality.assessment: The business was profitable in 2021-2023, with parent net profit of HK$23.597m, HK$18.510m and HK$15.746m. 2022-2023 operating cash flow exceeded accounting profit, but 2023 cash flow benefited from inventory release and later 2024 cross-check shows operating cash flow can drop when working capital normalizes. Main denominator uses the 2021-2023 median net profit and applies a 0.75 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Used HK$18.510m, the median of 2021-2023 reported parent net profit, as pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit.
Excluded interest income logic from the owner-earnback denominator because cash and short-term deposits are deducted in the detachable net cash calculation.

Did not add back 2023 investment-property revaluation loss and PPE impairment into the main denominator, despite their non-cash nature, because property value decline and underutilized PRC facilities are part of the business context.
Applied a 0.75 profit haircut for export manufacturing cyclicality, two-major-customer concentration, inventory/receivables swings and uncertainty over maintenance versus growth capex.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 operating cash flow HK$58.535m less capex HK$4.265m was HK$54.270m; 2022 was HK$58.243m on the same simple FCF basis. Later 2024 cross-check was HK$16.353m, showing cash conversion volatility.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable positive profits and strong recent cash flow support a positive denominator, but customer concentration and working-capital release mean a full 0.9-1.0 factor is not justified.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Positive but volatile; 2023 cash flow was flattered by inventory reduction.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2023 capex HK$4.265m, 2022 HK$1.673m and 2024 HK$5.303m suggest required annual capex is not heavy relative to profit, but Vietnam equipment investment creates some reinvestment need.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Inventory fell HK$28.635m in 2023 while receivables increased HK$16.587m; customer concentration and seasonal receivables require a discount rather than using the best cash-flow year.

evidence.note: Signal date 2024-05-16 close HK$0.55, 198,958,000 shares; input market cap CNY 99,251,296.78 converted back at HKD/CNY 0.9070100188.
HK$22.965m cash at banks/in hand plus HK$16.043m short-term time deposits.
PRC HK$4.979m and Vietnam HK$6.308m deposits subject to exchange control restrictions.
Hong Kong listed equity securities, Level 1 fair value.
Bank loans and trust receipt loans nil at 2023 year-end.

evidence.value: 2021-2023 net profit HK$23.597m/HK$18.510m/HK$15.746m; 2023 operating cash flow HK$58.535m and capex HK$4.265m
evidence.source: 2023 annual report financial highlights, income statement and cash flow statement
evidence.note: Used to set and haircut the sustainable distributable cash profit denominator.

limitations: Market cap is the historical signal-date rough-screen market cap, not a current quote.
The annual report does not fully split cash by parent company and operating subsidiaries; cash haircuts are therefore conservative.
Necessary operating cash is estimated from revenue/cost scale and working-capital volatility rather than disclosed by management.
2021 cash-flow details were not extracted; later 2024 cash flow is used only to cross-check volatility, not to revise 2023 facts.
